physical: Real audio device reports and offscreen Metal; no acoustic, compositor or physical display timing
timing: Scheduling timestamps sampled by UI, not precise dispatch or acknowledgment times
runtime: Actual selected provider/runtime and plan retained in each durable request; temporary runtime configuration and conditioning bytes were not archived before cancellation
originals: Large original media excluded. Fixture paths, hashes and sizes retained in fixture-preparation.json; generated testsrc2+sine recipe documented in docs/qualification/performance-2026-10-04.md
sources: Collection-time source snapshots must not be silently substituted for executed source pins
